claims.text: Shakespeare's Globe is a stunning and authentic reconstruction of the original Elizabethan playhouse that was built in 1599.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: The original theatre is famously the venue for which the legendary playwright William Shakespeare wrote many of his greatest plays.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: Spearheaded by Sam Wanamaker and built using traditional techniques, the reconstruction was finally completed in 1997.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: The new theatre is highly celebrated, and its official opening was even attended by Queen Elizabeth II.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: While the main outdoor stage hosts incredible theatrical productions during the summer months, the complex also features the indoor Sam Wanamaker Playhouse.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: If you want to catch a show but didn't book ahead, tickets are often available on the day if you are prepared to stand in the yard.
claims.subject: self
